description:
Advances: specled.next, specled.package

From specled_-hj4.3 verification + audit (2026-07-25). TICKET-AUTHORED SEAM, not implementer error — the hj4.3 ticket instructed hoisting the sentence to a shared constant "referenced by prime.ex, next.ex and both test files", which makes the assertions compare the constant against itself.

MUTATION-PROVEN: replacing the body of SpecLedEx.Next.verdict_read_protocol/0 with "MUTANT: totally different sentence." left 12 tests passing and mix spec.check at result=pass. Precise statement of the hazard: a unilateral edit to the shared constant is now silent. (NOT "the only tripwire against a wrong sentence shipping" — the base tree falsifies that: all four pre-hoist literals carried the OLD FALSE sentence and matched each other with a green suite. Duplicate literals guard DIVERGENCE, not truth.)

Fix (a) — restores deliberateness, not truth:
  assert SpecLedEx.Next.verdict_read_protocol() == "<literal>"
one golden test, so any future wording change is a deliberate two-place edit.

Fix (b) — the doc-corpus seam, separate and pre-existing: specled.package.adoption_guide and concepts_guide are covered ONLY by existence-only kind: source_file entries. Proven: deleting all four protocol sentences from docs/adoption.md and docs/concepts.md still returns result=pass. The package.spec.md spec-verification block is byte-identical between f338abb and af5e005 (sha256 4084f551839d2b2b), so this seam predates the epic. Consider a kind: command verification with execute: true that greps the doc surfaces for the exact string. Weigh carefully: it binds ~14 markdown surfaces into the gate.

Ticket-template correction for future use: write the CF3-style instruction as "...referenced by prime.ex and next.ex; keep ONE golden test asserting the constant against a literal so the text cannot change silently, and have the task tests reference the constant."

## Spec co-change authorization

Editing .spec/specs/next.spec.md and .spec/specs/package.spec.md (the Advances: subjects) and the tool-managed baseline .spec/realization_hashes.json is IN SCOPE. Additional minimal prose-only reconciliation edits to OTHER subject specs are authorized ONLY when the spec gate itself demands them (branch_guard_missing_subject_update) — keep them to the smallest edit that keeps the gate green, and make sure every file such a note names is genuinely in your diff. This authorization comes before any scope warning below.

## Allowed touches

- test/mix/tasks/spec_next_task_test.exs
- test/mix/tasks/spec_prime_task_test.exs
- .spec/specs/next.spec.md
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md
- .spec/realization_hashes.json

## Out of Scope (files)

- lib/** — the constant SpecLedEx.Next.verdict_read_protocol/0 already exists; do NOT change its wording or signature
- docs/** — read-only surfaces here; fix (b) binds them via spec verification, not by editing them
- skills/**
- test/** other than the two named task test files

## Out of Scope (intent)

- Do not reword the verdict read-protocol sentence itself
- No new deps; no refactors of prime.ex/next.ex
- Fix (b) is a JUDGMENT CALL the ticket explicitly leaves open ("Consider ... Weigh carefully"): decide, and document the decision and its rationale in the completion record. If you add the command verification, it must grep for the exact constant string and be execute: true; if you decline, say why (e.g. binding ~14 markdown surfaces into the gate).

## Verification

- mix spec.check --no-run-commands passes on the stage branch
- Fix (a) landed: one golden test asserts SpecLedEx.Next.verdict_read_protocol() equals the exact literal sentence (the literal typed out in the test, NOT referencing the constant), tagged to the appropriate spec requirement id(s)
- MUTATION CHECK re-run: temporarily replacing the constant's body must now fail at least the golden test (revert the mutation before committing; report the result in the completion record)
- If fix (b) adopted: the new kind: command verification is execute: true and fails when a protocol sentence is deleted from a bound doc surface (prove once, revert)
- Targeted: the two named test files green; mix format --check-formatted clean
title: Golden test + doc-coverage binding for the verdict read-protocol sentence
